/query/query.reason: Released handle_search uses the literal query for the Cellosaurus request but serializes pagination, count, results, data_as_of, data_as_of_kind and _meta without a query echo. The explicit limit remains projected separately.

/schema.reason: Released FaersSearchResponse has no schema identifier.

/status.reason: Released disabled OpenFDA errors degrade to FaersSearchStatus::Unavailable, which serializes an empty FAERS search response at exit zero, without a top-level lifecycle status.

/sources/0/state.reason: Released FAERS unavailability records a section outcome and empty rows, with no current per-source policy state.

/sources/0/reason.reason: Released optional FAERS failures collapse to Unavailable and lose the disabled-policy reason; the response has no sources reason field.

unprojectable.reason: The case asserts /status, /query/source, /sources/0/state and /sources/0/reason. Released search drug imatinib --region us uses MyChem, but disabling mychem-info returns a generic error envelope without lifecycle status, query, or a sources array. Its disabled-source public projection deliberately sets source to None, so the asserted MyChem query selector cannot project from /error/source either. None of these four assertions has a released serialized counterpart.

The case asserts /status=failed, /sources/0/reason=syncing and /next/0/args=[sync,ema] for a missing local bundle without a download. Released search drug Tibsovo --region eu opens EmaClient::ready(Auto) and synchronizes missing files before searching. It has no equivalent stored-only missing-bundle outcome or typed next arguments; a network or disabled-source failure would answer a different question. No baseline request is attempted.

The case asserts /status=failed, /sources/0/reason=syncing and /next/0/args=[sync,who-pq] for a missing local bundle without a download. Released search drug trastuzumab --region who opens WhoPqClient::ready(Auto) and synchronizes missing exports before searching. It has no equivalent stored-only missing-bundle outcome or typed next arguments; a network or disabled-source failure would answer a different question. No baseline request is attempted.

The case inspects the canonical error schema artifact and asserts /$id=biomcp.error/1 and /type=object. The released top-level command enum has no schema command or schema-inspection surface. Its runtime error JSON is an instance, not a schema artifact, and cannot answer either schema assertion.
